overview: The Northern Wei was founded by the Tuoba clan of the Xianbei people and became the most successful of the Northern Dynasties. It promoted Buddhism, sinicization policies and created institutions that influenced later Chinese dynasties.

items.text: The Yungang cave temples carved near Datong, with massive Buddha statues.
Emperor Xiaowen promotes sinicization: Xianbei must adopt Chinese language, dress and surnames.
The equal-field system implemented, distributing land to peasant households.
The equal-field system became a model for Sui and Tang land policies.
Buddhist cave temples at Yungang and Longmen remain major artistic achievements.

fall.text: Internal conflicts between military factions split Northern Wei into Eastern Wei and Western Wei in 534.
